findings.entity: Woman's hips and legs / diner counter
findings.description: After rising from the customer-side stool, the woman moves diagonally through the counter into the staff aisle. The continuous countertop edge cuts across her hips while her trailing leg remains visible on the customer side below it, then disappears through the solid front panel. She does not walk around an end or pass through an opening; the counter remains intact throughout the crossing.
